Name: Improved Fall Debris
Author: AvalonMFX
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/n9k82K7.png[/img]

Instead of loading recolored fall debris textures, the mod uses C# to shift the hue of the original debris texture. That makes the mod compatible with any Content Pack that resprites the texture. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/W1gSYfd.png[/img]﻿

[list]
[*][color=#6aa84f]Compatible with any resprite mods[/color]
[*][color=#6aa84f]Multiplayer Compatible[/color]
[*][color=#f1c232]Compatible with Mac and Windows - [/color][color=#f4f4f4]Windows works for sure. Due to Harmony, there might me issues for macOS Users. If you're a macOS user, please let me know if the mod works for you or not[/color]
[*][color=#f1c232]The mod uses Harmony and patches a method. If you're using a mod that is patching the same method, there might be issues[/color]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/iXMEreT.png[/img]
